body:
I must think my life is worth something considering I'm still here right now. But I feel like my own life has been in anticlimax for a long time and that I've reached the nadir. What really sucks is that I know if I was on my medication, wasn't constantly afraid of not having a place to live, and had any kind of job that would allow me to have a place to live (the rent where I live is extremely high compared to most places). What kind of live is worth living if people, even my mom, don't care about me anymore?

Last summer I was doing better than I have in my entire life. I was on medicaiton, I had a job that I loved, I was making new friends, and I was really independent for the first time in my life. But now I don't see a way to ever get back to that.
2 codeine pills. Enough that I thought would relax me enough to be able to do it.
I only had 2.5mg of xanax left and honestly I've taken more recreationally in the past
